name: PagesOne

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build VitePress docs
        env:
          BASE: "./"
        run: |
          if npm run docs:build; then
            echo "Docs built successfully"
          else
            echo "docs:build script not found, attempting vitepress build"
            npx vitepress build docs
          fi

      - name: Upload Pages Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: pages
          path: docs/.vitepress/dist

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: pages

name: PagesOne

    branches: [main]

  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build VitePress docs
        env:
          BASE: "./"
        run: |
          if npm run docs:build; then
            echo "Docs built successfully"
          else
            echo "docs:build script not found, attempting vitepress build"
            npx vitepress build docs
          fi

      - name: Upload Pages Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: pages
          path: docs/.vitepress/dist

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: pages
